_about: Public-domain Thomas Coke (1747-1814, first Methodist bishop and father of Methodist missions) for the Word Hoard: his sermon at Francis Asbury's ordination (Baltimore, 1784), the Extracts of the Journals of his Five Visits to America (1793), An Account of the Methodist Missions in the West Indies (1805), and A History of the West Indies (3 vols, 1808-1811), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 33 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

coke-asbury-ordination-sermon: The Substance of a Sermon Preached at Baltimore at the Ordination of the Rev. Francis Asbury (London: J. Paramore for T. Scollick; year garbled, catalogued 1785)
coke-journals-america: Extracts of the Journals of the Rev. Dr. Coke's Five Visits to America (London: G. Paramore, 1793)
coke-west-indies-missions: An Account of the Progress of the Methodist Missions in the West-Indies (London: Conference Office, 1805)
coke-history-west-indies-1: A History of the West Indies, vol. I (Liverpool: Nuttall, Fisher, and Dixon, 1808)
coke-history-west-indies-2: A History of the West Indies, vol. II (London: for the Author, 1810)
coke-history-west-indies-3: A History of the West Indies, vol. III (London: for the Author, 1811)

_alternates.coke-copies: Other copies of the West Indies and Extracts; the 1815 New York sermon on the Godhead of Christ; the posthumous 1816 Journals with Sutcliffe's life; the Life of Wesley with Henry Moore (1792)

_excluded.coke-others: Edward Coke and E. T. Coke; the 1969 reprint of the West Indies
